races.title: State House, District 63
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Ian Baltutis
cands.bio: Democratic candidate for NC House District 63. Mayor of Burlington 2015–2021, now on the Burlington City Council. Entrepreneur: co-founder of Vibration Solution LLC and Burlington Beer Works, owner of Persnickety Books. Former Honda Power Equipment supply chain manager. Elon University graduate (2008) with a UNC-Chapel Hill planning degree.

endorsements.text: Self-reported in his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey: Sierra Club, Planned Parenthood Votes, Transgender Caucus of the North Carolina, Work for Democracy, Alamance Burlington Association of Educators.

cands.gaps: We could not find where Baltutis was born or exactly when he moved to North Carolina. We found no documented statements or actions on data centers, homestead property tax elimination, limits on out-of-state or institutional land buyers, immigration enforcement or H-1B visas, gun laws, abortion, or school vouchers and charters. His campaign materials mention affordable housing, 'smart growth', local control and public school funding in general terms only. We did not find his specific votes as mayor or city councilmember, or any news coverage of controversies.

local.label: Roots 40: He says he chose Burlington as his hometown as a college student and has lived and served in Alamance County since, including as mayor 2015–2021. That is roughly two decades as an adult, with a Minnesota upbringing implied but not stated outright.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Burlington mayor for six years (2015–2021) and current city councilmember. Master's in City and Regional Planning from UNC-Chapel Hill. Founder or co-founder of several small businesses, and a former supply chain manager at Honda Power Equipment. Lost a 2014 NC House race.
qual.why: Local elected executive experience, planning and budget-related training, and business ownership put him in the middle-to-upper range. He has no prior state legislative service.

cands.name: Ryan Moffitt
cands.bio: Republican candidate for North Carolina House District 63. Attorney based in Burlington, a graduate of the College of Charleston and Elon University School of Law. Chairman of the Alamance Chamber of Commerce. No prior elected office is documented.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Ryan Moffitt was born or raised, or when he moved to North Carolina. We found no stated positions from him on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, campaign money, policing, guns, abortion or schools. His campaign site has no issues page, and he did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey. We found no documented endorsements, no controversies and no foreign ties. His years of legal practice and the firm he works for are not listed in the pages we had.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.
score.why_money: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Practicing attorney; Chairman of the Alamance Chamber of Commerce; member of the North Carolina Bar Association and the Alamance Community Foundation. No prior elected office is documented.
qual.why: He is a lawyer, which fits the middle band for this office. No legislative service or budget career is documented. The chamber chairmanship is a civic board seat and the memberships add nothing, so neither raised the score.
